newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-BELGIAN DE BILDE PUNCHES PLAYER, MAY BE SUED AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BELGIAN DE BILDE PUNCHES PLAYER, MAY BE SUED AGAIN.

text.p: Belgian club Aalst on Sunday urged Krist Porte to sue Belgium striker Gilles De Bilde for punching Porte in the face during a league match on Saturday, breaking his nose and eye socket.
"I had several examinations this morning. My nose and eye socket are both fractured in several places," Porte told BRTN radio.

Porte, who left the pitch with a blood-covered face and was taken to hospital, said he had not decided yet whether to take legal action against De Bilde, who was suspended until further notice by Anderlecht.
De Bilde, who was not sent off and completed the match, already has to stand trial for assault after head-butting one male nurse and punching another last year.

"Porte has to respect himself and, of course, do a number of things to protect himself. Just imagine that there is permanent injury," Aalst manager Patrick Orlans said. "He might be unable to work for several months," he added.
De Bilde, who won the 1994 award for best Belgian league player, attacked the nurses when he was denied access to a hospital room where his father was being treated for a heart attack in August 1995.
BRTN said that Aalst themselves would not sue De Bilde but challenge the outcome of the game which they lost 3-0.
